title: Tools (.sddpp/tools.yaml)
description: Which tool (a skill, a plugin or an MCP server) a person chose for each role in this project, or that the choice waits or is not needed. Only what a person chose is written here: the project may be public, so what a machine has installed never goes in this file. The roles are a list kept in code (ppc rules, K01); see docs/tools.md.

trigger.description: What asks again: the design gets a component of that kind.

name.description: As the tool is named where it is used: a skill (`plugin:skill` for one a plugin brings), a plugin, or an MCP server.

source.description: Where it comes from: a repository or a marketplace. Optional for a person's own skill.

pinned.description: The commit or version that was read and chosen.

access.description: MCP only: whether the server may change anything (data, files, a remote service). Read-write is a person's decision with its reason.

access_reason.description: MCP with read-write access only: why the server has to change things.

check.description: A one-line command that shows the tool can do its job in this project, on this machine (for a capture tool, capturing one real screen). `ppc tools --check` runs it; being installed is not being able to do the job.

reason.description: Why the role is not needed.

history.description: Earlier decisions, oldest first. A change never erases why it was decided before.
